HexKagune 6.0.8 for Forge 1.20.1 (needs PlayerAnimator, bendy-lib and Photon on clients; the server needs only Forge). Install on both the client and the server.

**Changed in 6.0.8**
- The kakugan's veins now twist and arch like real veins instead of running in straight lines, and the red cracks inside the eye zigzag like lightning (kept as light to draw as before, and never curling in toward the nose). Visual only.
- Includes 6.0.7 (stronger one-eyed kakugan) and 6.0.6 (ghouls can't eat normal food; AppleSkin icons no longer cover the flesh reserve bar).
- 6.0.8 works with any 6.0 server and players.
